summary: SEO platform with API and MCP access to keyword, backlink, SERP and rank-tracking data.
access_note: Data API is sold as annual credit packages; a free trial of the platform exists but the API plan is paid.
blocker_note: Data API credit plans are annual paid packages.

evidence.quote: Include an `Authorization` header in your request, with the value `Token YOUR_API_KEY`.
Our Data API credit plans are available as annual packages.
First, you'll need to generate a unique API key from your account dashboard.
Our MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports.

notes: Landing page (seranking.com/api) says API access is included in every plan and offers a free trial; the getting-started page says Data API plans are annual packages. Conflict unresolved. REST inferred, not stated. MCP also supports OAuth 2.1.
